entry.content:
This is a placeholder post. Delete it once you write something real.

Posts live in _posts/ and are named YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md. The block between the two --- lines is the front matter: it sets the title, date, and optional description, tags, and categories. Everything below it is plain Markdown.

Math works out of the box with $$ ... $$:

\[E = mc^2\]

So do code blocks, images via the figure include, footnotes, and callouts. To keep a post as a draft, set published: false in the front matter.
